name: Neu Wulmstorf (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over orange, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Neu Wulmstorf (a blue pile with a white ring on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Neu Wulmstorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Neu Wulmstorf arms — pile with ring on yellow
